greeting: Barrels! Barrels! Get your custom barrels!
Cooper-Klaus! I make containers that HOLD things!
You look like you need storage! I make STORAGE!
Back for another barrel? Running out of space?
Welcome to my cooperage! Where wood becomes WONDER!
New customer? Need a barrel? Cask? Keg? I make 'em ALL!
Metal or wood! Your choice! Both hold liquid!
The finest barrels in Tide! Waterproof! Mostly!
dialog.barrel_offer: Standard barrels! Wine casks! Waterproof tubs! Even barrel backpacks! For the adventurous!
dialog.cooper_craft: It's an ART! Steam the wood! Bend the staves! Hoops hold it all! MAGIC! Well, physics. But STILL!
dialog.metal_vs_wood: Wood breathes! Metal's strong! Both have PURPOSE! Don't let Bob tell you otherwise!
dialog.dustbelt_rivalry: Barrelman Bob in Dustbelt? Thinks wood is BEST. I say: METAL HOOPS on wood! BEST of BOTH!
rumor: Tide's humidity is HELL on wood. Good for business! Constant repairs!
Mire needs barrels that FLOAT. Special order. Challenging.
Frost's barrels FREEZE. Crack the wood. Poor design.
Ember tried metal barrels. MELTED. Classic Ember.
dialog.crafting_philosophy: A good barrel is like a good friend! Dependable! Holds your secrets! ...And your wine!
farewell: Roll on back! Ha! Barrel humor!
Come back when you need MORE containment!
dialog.time_dawn: Early crafting! Wood steams best in morning!

party_reactions.kade: Another barrel specialist. This zone has storage needs.
party_reactions.nix7: Container engineering: adequate. Metal reinforcement: wise.
party_reactions.twist: Can I get a barrel BACKPACK?! REALLY?!
party_reactions.korr: Good craftsmanship shows in the details. Yours show well.
party_reactions.renna: Do you make magical containers? Warded barrels?
party_reactions.suresh: To make something both useful and beautiful is a gift.
party_reactions.sova: I need a quiver. Waterproof. Possible?
party_reactions.grit: Good barrels saved supplies in the war. Important work.
party_reactions.ashka: Wood burns. Metal doesn't. Just saying.
party_reactions.senna: Barrels make good hiding spots. Good for smuggling.
party_reactions.callum: The hoops are so shiny! Nice work!

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Regular customer! How's that cask holding up?
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Discount on all repairs!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Lifetime warranty! Best I offer!
